subject: Cloud marketplace vendor setup: PO intake, tax docs, and activation timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@cloudatlas.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudatlas.com
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood marketplace onboarding / PO process

Hi Irene,

Thanks for picking this up — we chatted at the partner summit and CloudAtlas is ready to list Redwood in our AWS and GCP marketplaces. Procurement asked me to get the intake paperwork and PO routing steps so we can open a purchase order and schedule the marketplace listing date.

Can you confirm:
- The exact vendor/legal name and tax info you need (EIN, W-9 or equivalent).
- Preferred PO recipient email and billing contact for Redwood invoices.
- Any marketplace-specific paperwork (AWS seller form, Azure partner ID) we should complete before you can accept a PO.
- Typical SLA for listing once PO is issued (assume standard review).

I've attached our vendor intake template (we typically attach it to our PO). If there's a separate Redwood intake form, please send it and any internal contact for billing.

Thanks — aim to get the PO issued this week if possible.

Best,
Sarah Ng
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudAtlas, Inc.
Attachments: CloudAtlas_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@cloudatlas.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace onboarding / PO process

Hi Sarah — great to connect. Thanks for the intake form, and congrats on moving this forward. Outline below is the minimal set to get a PO processed and for us to start marketplace enablement:

Required for PO processing (send to billing@redwood.ai or attach to the PO):
- Legal entity name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID / EIN: 21-3456789 (we will also attach a completed W-9)
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.ai (attn: Vendor Billing / Ben Carter)
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears; Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated

Marketplace enablement & vendor forms (can run in parallel):
- AWS: Seller registration + marketplace listing form. We will provide our AWS seller ID once PO is received.
- GCP: Partner registration + billing account linkage. We need the marketplace account ID from you.
- Azure: If you plan to list, we require the Azure Publisher ID (optional in first wave).

Attachments I am sending: Redwood_Marketplace_Vendor_Intake.xlsx (simple checklist + required field map) and Redwood_W-9.pdf. Please attach these to your PO or upload to your vendor portal.

Notes and timeline:
- Once we receive a valid PO referencing Redwood Inference, Inc. and a PO number, our finance team will provision a billing record (24–48 hours).
- Marketplace ops will start preflight checks on listing assets as soon as the billing record exists; typical go-live readiness for a standard listing is 5–10 business days after PO issuance (depends on asset readiness and marketplace queue).
- If you need a faster SLA, we can discuss a prioritized onboarding path (requires a signed expedited addendum).

Ben: can you confirm the billing email and whether we need a specific invoice header/line-item format for CloudAtlas?
Vanessa: please monitor marketplace ops for AWS/GCP seller ID assignments after the PO is opened.

Thanks — I’ll hold here until we have the PO number and the attached forms back from you.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Vendor_Intake.xlsx; Redwood_W-9.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@cloudatlas.com>, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace onboarding / PO process

Hi Sarah — looping in billing details. A couple quick items to make sure the PO routes without delay: 

1) Please make PO line item readable for our accounting system. Recommended format: 
   - SKU: RED-MKT-AWS (or RED-MKT-GCP)
   - Description: Redwood Inference — Hosted Inference API access (monthly)
   - Quantity: 1
   - Unit price: TBD (we will invoice against consumption)

2) Invoice header: 
   - Payable to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Address: 1220 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94103

3) Tax documents: thanks for sending vendor intake. I attached our W-9 (Redwood_W-9.pdf) for your records. If your AP team requires a signed vendor agreement or specific remittance details, please flag now.

4) Invoice delivery: billing@redwood.ai is preferred; if your system needs a PO-contact, put "Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>" as AP contact.

Vanessa will follow up on marketplace seller ID mapping once the PO number is live. If you want Redwood to accept a marketplace-managed invoice flow (e.g., AWS consolidated billing), note that on the PO and we can align with your marketplace admin.

Thanks — attaching Redwood_W-9.pdf for convenience.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_W-9.pdf

From: Sarah Ng <sarah.ng@cloudatlas.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudatlas.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2026 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace onboarding / PO process

Irene / Ben — thanks for the clear checklist and the W-9. Procurement issued PO #7391 today and I attached the signed PO for your records.

Quick confirmations:
- PO number: 7391 (see attached PO_7391_CloudAtlas.pdf)
- We referenced SKU: RED-MKT-AWS for the initial purchase lane and marked billing delivery to billing@redwood.ai
- Marketplace account IDs: AWS acct 987654321012; GCP billing acct cloudatlas-billing-01 (we'll share publisher IDs in a follow-up)
- Expected go-live ask: aiming for marketplace listing on or before May 12 — let us know if the 5–10 business day window still applies (we're prepared to provide any additional marketing assets).

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt of the PO and a target activation date.
- If there are any missing fields on the PO, tell us and we can reissue quickly.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround.

Best,
Sarah Ng
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudAtlas, Inc.
